question: Who among the following is the pioneer and founder of Kirana Gharana of Hindustani music?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Abdul Karim Khan**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Abdul Karim Khan** is recognized as the pioneer and founder of the Kirana Gharana of Hindustani music.
 
• The Kirana Gharana is one of the most prominent schools of Hindustani classical music.
